label: Fires at D1 after a rewarded common a2->S2 trial, stronger early and when belief still leans S1.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * ep_trial
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * ep_trial
explanation: Sparse feature (nonzero on 3% of steps), active only at D1. Its magnitude is driven by the previous trial being a rewarded visit to S2, mainly a2 S2 r (common); a1 S2 r (rare) gives a weaker response. Within a2 S2 r it is larger early in the episode and when the observer belief still favours S1 (a less expected S2 reward), and smaller when the trial before was also rewarded. GO and D2 are always zero. The free fit adds a1 S2 r terms and the two-back reward and state. The observed-only ceiling is low (all observed 0.18); the model value decile (0.26) explains more, so much of the firing variance is not captured by observed history. Upcoming choice a2 (future) explains little (about 0.1).
